family: Junior kart: minimum age 8 and minimum height 135 cm. The site describes the junior category as ages 8-12.
Adult kart: minimum age 13 and minimum height 150 cm.
Duo kart passenger: minimum age 3. Passenger eligibility is not driver eligibility; driver requirements and whether different kart categories share a heat are not verified.
group: Published race arrangements start at 15 or 25 people respectively; these are separate formats, not a universal minimum for all visits.
Children's birthday arrangement: 6-12 people, two 8-minute drives, refreshments and food. Not a plain driving session.
Official page offers direct reservations. Confirm group dates and format with the operator.

family: Regular sessions require age 14+ and minimum height 140 cm.
If anyone in the party is under 14 and above 140 cm, the whole party must book a family session. Adults and children then drive together at reduced speed.
Closed, flat shoes are required. Participants must understand Dutch or English. Confirm individual suitability and requirements with the operator.
group: Published team endurance formats last one, two or three hours and allow at most eight teams. The page gives examples of 25, 50, 75 or 100 participants; these examples are not interpreted as a minimum booking size.
Endurance includes a prize ceremony. Price per person, individual driving allocation and minimum group size remain unverified.
Official page links to family-session reservations. Do not book a regular session for a mixed under-14/adult party.
